question: Karaga, one of the oldest festivals of ____________, is celebrated in honour of Goddess Shakti.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. __Karnataka__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Karaga is the festival in Karnataka__. It is one of the oldest festivals of Karnataka.
 
• Karaga is celebrated in honor of Goddess Shakti at the famous Dharmarayaswamy temple in Bangalore.
 
• The festival showcases the rich cultural heritage of Karnataka.
 
• It is an auspicious festival of the Thigala community who, according to the popular legend, was part of a mythological army who helped Draupadi in her fight against a demon.
 
• Draupadi took the form of Shakti and gathered an army of Veerakumaras, the ancestors of the Thigala community.
 
• The festival is celebrated for nine days with splendid rituals and processions

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh:** The state of Andhra Pradesh has several festivals that are celebrated in honor of different deities. Some of the popular festivals in Andhra Pradesh are Ugadi, Dussehra, and Sankranti.
 
• **Kerala:** Kerala is known for its vibrant culture and festivals. Some of the popular festivals in Kerala are Onam, Vishu, and Thrissur Pooram.
 
• **Tamil Nadu:** Tamil Nadu is famous for its rich cultural heritage and festivals. Some of the popular festivals in Tamil Nadu are Pongal, Diwali, and Navratri.
